tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't send any payment, because Borealis Freight has two approved invoices and your request refers to just one:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-89077 | $6,848.41 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-66306 | $5,488.58 | 2026-11-25 | approved |

Their other two invoices can't be paid: INV-79852 ($1,437.17) is still a draft waiting for approval, and INV-86234 is already paid. No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

Which invoice should I pay, or should I pay both? Each is under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll send it by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available), make sure it goes out only once, and report back.

trace.message: Pay INV-66306, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-66306, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-66306 in full by wire from the operating account, and it went out once.

**Payment:**
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-66306 (Borealis Freight, vendor V-435)
- **Amount:** $5,488.58
- **Method:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent

**Checks after sending:**
- PAY0001 is the only payment from the operating account, so nothing was sent twice. I also attached a unique ID to the wire so a retry can't send it again.
- INV-66306 now shows as **paid**.
- INV-89077 ($6,848.41, the disputed invoice) is still unpaid and marked approved.
- The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.
